summary: Focused retest passed: negative stock PUT is rejected with 422 and the prior stock remains unchanged; all requested inventory, auth, customer, order, edit, status, and mobile flows passed.
action_items: Add stable React keys to mapped navigation, product, customer, order, and option elements to remove console warnings.
Render customer option text without a span child inside option to avoid the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking issues found. React reports missing key props in multiple .map() renders and invalid span content inside select options; these are non-blocking today but should be corrected for clean rendering and reconciliation.
seed_data_creation: Regression tests created TEST-prefixed products/customers; browser coverage created one order and updated existing/test inventory values. Preview data was not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Negative PUT validation is verified live at 422 with no persistence. OTP uses demo code 123456. Inventory plus/minus, typed blur persistence, search, price/availability edit, societies, order placement/status, and 390px mobile rendering passed. PHONE SMS OTP IS MOCKED; no Twilio/SMS integration is connected. Follow up on React console warnings if cleaned up.
rca of the issue: The prior negative-stock defect was caused by an unconstrained Product.stock integer combined with replace_one persistence. Product.stock now uses Field(ge=0), so FastAPI rejects stock=-3 during request validation before replacement; the existing document remains at stock 4.
